name: Digital Electronics
description: Number systems, conversions, Boolean algebra, arithmetic operations, logic gates, SOP, POS, minterms, maxterms, K-maps, design minimization, adders (half/full), ripple carry adder, carry look ahead adder (4-bit, 16-bit, 64-bit), adder-timing analysis, parity circuits, multiplexers, decoders, encoders, switch based implementation of logic circuits and their analysis, latches, flip-flops, registers, asynchronous and synchronous counters, finite state machines, mealy and Moore FSMs, clock, timing analysis, introduction to memories, VHDL or Verilog.
